headline: AI Lab Financials Under Scrutiny
detail: Anthropic is disclosing revenue, and Character.ai filed for bankruptcy. This highlights the financial pressures and litigation risks in the AI space, which could impact sentiment for related tech names.
rec: No action based on this headline alone. Monitor AI sector financials for broader implications.

headline: Leveraged ETF Decay
detail: Your MUU, SOXL, and SPAL are all leveraged ETFs flagged SELL. These instruments are designed to decay over time, especially in volatile markets, amplifying your losses and hurting your margin.
rec: Consider trimming MUU and SOXL to reduce exposure to decay and volatility. Re-evaluate your stop levels on these positions.

headline: Semiconductor Sector Pressure
detail: While not explicitly stated in headlines, the broad weakness in your leveraged chip ETFs (SOXL, MUU) suggests underlying pressure in the semiconductor sector. SMH is also flagged TRIM.
rec: Evaluate trimming SMH to reduce exposure given its TRIM status and the broader sector weakness.
